executiveSummary: System conditions remain stable and overall operational readiness across the hurricane protection system remains Green. All major flood protection assets are operational, second-quarter inspections are nearing completion, and no threats to system integrity have been identified. While staffing shortages remain the agency's primary readiness challenge, the organization remains focused on hurricane season operations, project execution, workforce development, infrastructure reliability, and maintaining public confidence in the region's flood protection system.
maintenanceActivities: Floodwalls, levees, gates, and valves continue routine inspection and maintenance activities with no impacts to system readiness.
Seasonal storm readiness measures, including sandbag staging and facility preparation, are underway.
Critical facilities, generators, and support infrastructure remain operational.
Routine maintenance and repairs on equipment.
Rotational Valve Testing: 84 of 105 valves inspected in Q2.
